problem: Division by zero created NaN/inf in conversion_rate
impact: Unstable features and downstream clustering quality
resolution: Use safe division with NaN replacement and fill to 0

problem: DB/table errors were unhandled and opaque to users
impact: Training failed with unclear error messages
resolution: Add explicit DB existence check and wrap read_sql with clear RuntimeError

problem: model_loaded relied only on file existence
resolution: Load model and report True only if deserialization succeeds

problem: Assumed users and labels lengths match; fixed-size counts array
impact: Index errors and incorrect UI counts
resolution: Truncate to common length; compute dynamic counts then pad to 5

problem: Fixed-size counts array not robust to model n_clusters
impact: Incorrect totals for non-5 cluster models
resolution: Compute counts size from labels max and pad to 5 for UI
